title: Auditing MCQA Benchmarks through Probability Landscapes
abstract: arXiv:2608.30372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Large Language Models rapidly advance, performance on standard multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks is reaching saturation. While the community has responded by developing increasingly difficult datasets, validating question quality and filtering flawed items remains a labor-intensive process. To provide a scalable diagnostic approach, we propose a two-component probabilistic framework for auditing MCQA benchmarks using model output distributions. First, for benchmark-level analysis, we characterize the probability landscape using the top prediction probability ($P_{top1}$) and normalized residual entropy ($H_{norm}$), summarized globally by Mean Pairwise Distance (MPD). Second, for item-level diagnostics, we introduce noise injection to reduce meaningful distractor competition, enabling us to flag candidate items for targeted human review and categorize residual failure patterns. translated_title: 通过概率景观审计多项选择题问答（MCQA）基准
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型的快速发展，模型在标准多项选择题问答（MCQA）基准上的性能正趋于饱和。虽然社区通过构建越来越困难的数据集来应对这一挑战，但验证题目质量和过滤有缺陷的题目仍然是一个劳动密集型的过程。为了提供一种可扩展的诊断方法，我们提出了一个由两个组件构成的概率框架，利用模型输出分布来审计MCQA基准。首先，在基准层面的分析中，我们使用最高预测概率（P_top1）和归一化残差熵（H_norm）来刻画概率景观，并通过平均成对距离（MPD）进行全局概括。其次，在题目层面的诊断中，我们引入噪声注入来减少有意义的干扰项竞争，从而标记出候选题目以供针对性的人工审查，并对剩余的失败模式进行分类。在四个MCQA基准上，我们的景观（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一个双组件概率审计框架：在基准层面利用最高预测概率、归一化残差熵和平均成对距离刻画概率景观，在题目层面通过噪声注入诊断标记有缺陷的题目，从而实现对MCQA基准质量的可扩展检测。
en_tdlr: We propose a two-component probabilistic framework that audits MCQA benchmarks by characterizing probability landscapes (P_top1, H_norm, MPD) at the benchmark level and using noise injection diagnostics to flag flawed items at the item level, enabling scalable benchmark quality assessment.
